description.description: A split-screen image showing a 'before and after' comparison of a man. The left side shows him healthy and smiling, holding a bouquet of red roses next to a woman in front of a house. The right side shows the same man significantly emaciated and pale, appearing distressed while being hugged by a crying woman outdoors. They are both wrapped in a Ukrainian flag.
